geography: United States (ACADIA sells only in the U.S.)
moa: Synthetic analog of glycine-proline-glutamate (IGF-1 N-terminal tripeptide)

launch_evidence.quote: The FDA approved DAYBUE in March 2023 for the treatment of Rett syndrome and we launched the product in the United States in April 2023.

search_log: Listed every filing of ACADIA Pharmaceuticals (CIK 1070494) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks carrying item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row.

Rows: 'DAYBUE' (from the 2026Q2 10-Q 'DAYBUE products') of the net product sales by product table in each 10-Q, three-months column; Q4 = 10-K full year less the 10-Q nine months. Earnings releases print only total 'Product sales, net' except the 2026-02-25 release (DAYBUE Net Sales Q4 2025 109.6 million, matching the derived 109.633).
Checks: every NUPLAZID + DAYBUE quarter pair sums to the release's Product sales, net (e.g. 2023Q2 142,018 + 23,217 = 165,235).
